Bill.BriefDescription: Providing home rule charter cities the ability to choose their election system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing home rule charter cities the abilityto choose their election system; and amending RCW 29A.52.210.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29A.52.210 and 2003 c 111 s 1305 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All city and town primaries shall be nonpartisan. Primaries forspecial purpose districts, except those districts that requireownership of property within the district as a prerequisite to voting,shall be nonpartisan. City, town, and district primaries shall be heldas provided in RCW ((29A.04.310)) 29A.04.311, except where the charterof a first class city provides otherwise. The purpose of this section is to establish the holding of aprimary, subject to the exemptions in RCW 29A.52.220, as a uniformprocedural requirement to the holding of city, town, and districtelections, except where the charter of a first class city providesotherwise. These provisions supersede any and all other statutes,whether general or special in nature, having different election p. 1 SB 5326requirements.
